name: USDA crop-subtype yield atlas v1
scope: contiguous U.S. counties excluding California; non-durum spring wheat; 2010-2025
source: USDA NASS Quick Stats published county yields

validation.name: USDA crop-subtype yield atlas v1 validation

gate.rule: Leave-one-county-out transfer within 100 km needs final N >=100, Spearman >=0.50 with grouped-bootstrap lower >0.30; pre-final development/stability coverage >=78%/88%; locked 2023-2025 coverage 75-90%/87-96%; mean final 90% width <=0.80.

validation.interpretation: Nearby-county subtype ordering and uncertainty only; not parcel yield, revenue, or purchase returns.

spatialTransferValidation.method: Leave one reporting county out and use the nearest other county with earlier history within 100 km.

gate.rule: Leave-one-county-out transfer within 100 km needs final N >=100, Spearman >=0.50 with grouped-bootstrap lower >0.30; pre-final development/stability coverage >=78%/88%; locked 2023-2025 coverage 75-90%/87-96%; mean final 90% width <=0.80.

disclaimer: Observed subtype-specific county prior with split-conformal uncertainty; not a parcel yield forecast, causal estimate, or purchase recommendation.
